build_add_start_docstrings: add docstring text to the beginning of a decorated function or method
build_add_end_docstrings: append docstring text to the end of a decorated function or method
build_replace_return_docstrings: replace a Returns: placeholder in a function docstring with generated output documentation
build_add_code_sample_docstrings: add a code example and output documentation to a model method docstring
build_get_docstring_indentation_level: get the indentation level of a function or class docstring for proper formatting
